'''Bron Dooku''' (formally styled as '''His Grace, Bron Dooku, Count of Serenno''') was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House Dooku]] and the son of [[Adan Dooku|Adan]] and [[Maite Dooku]], and the grand-nephew of the infamous [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|You've done well by him since Maite died.''"<br />"''There's much of his mother in him&mdash;which makes me love him all the more.|Bail Organa and Adan Dooku|<ref name="AotE-HT1" />}}
Bron Dooku was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> into the [[House Dooku]], a [[Great Houses/Legends|powerful and influential house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], to [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku]], and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Maite Dooku]]. At some point, his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] [[Death/Legends|died]], leaving Adan to raise Bron on his own.<ref name="AotE-HT1" /> During his father's reign, Bron regularly travelled with Adan aboard the Dooku airship ''[[Windrunner/Legends|Windrunner]]''. As part of his training to become the next [[Count/Legends|Count]], he was taught by his father about [[Politics/Legends|politics]], and how to look at situations realistically and pragmatically.<ref name="AotE-HT2" />

===Death of Adan Dooku===
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref>The date of this story is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Bron was present on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for the [[25th anniversary of the settling of the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention|twenty-fifth anniversary]] of the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]]. During the reception he met [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and complimented her on her beauty.<ref name="AotE-HT1" />

Later that evening, he was in his bedroom in the suite he shared with his father when he was awakened by the argument between his father and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. When he came out of his room to see what the commotion was, he witnessed his father being shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Jahan Cross]]. Organa quickly grabbed Bron and got him under cover for safety as security forces gave chase, intent on finding Bron's father's killer.<ref name="AotE-HT1" />

===Regency===
Following the death of his father, Bron went with the other House Lords aboard the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']] to decide his fate. He then met Jahan Cross, whom he knew as Ambassador Cross's son. Bron was then kidnapped by [[Aveca Dunn]] during the ''[[Bloodskull]]''{{'s}} attack,<ref name="AotE-HT2" /> and was rescued by Cross.<ref name="AotE-HT3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref> Bron was taken to [[Otoh Dooku]], where Borgin's security chief [[Hovus Jorrick]] and his guard watched over him until Cross and [[Candra Tymon]] took him.<ref>[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref> He was pursued by Jorrick's guard and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], until Fett fired a missile at his shuttle, appearing to kill Bron.<ref name=":0">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>

In reality, though, Bron had been taken to Alderaan to be raised by Bail Organa until he took his title and position as Serenno's regent if he wanted to.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
While Bron Dooku's eye color was blue throughout [[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets|''Star Wars: Agent of the Empire—Hard Targets'']],<ref name="AotE-HT1" /><ref name=":0" /> the cover of the series' [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]] had them brown.<ref name=":0" />
